_comment: Fire under and around: a sea of lava, and the land, its features and its biomes leaning molten, lava lakes
and magma among them. Offered, yielding to the book: rock of basalt or magma, a red or orange sky, a light
the colour of the fire. No embers in the air: they are the inferno's warning that an Age burns now.
It absorbed `burning`, which barred the same tag lower and so chose the same sea (retired.json).
